text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, that felt quite good. At this 
rate, even the Kikuka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
choice_data_list:
Is there something catching your 
attention?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...! I apologize. I seem to have 
lost my focus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall collect myself and go for one more 
lap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Easier said than done, though...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That makes one lap around the academy 
grounds... I should probably wrap things 
up soon—oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Good work. You're really pushing hard for 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was a race I placed great 
importance on, even among the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see. So McQueen really does have strong 
feelings about the Kikuka Sho after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: When saying "Me too," as expected—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, looks like Ryan's working hard too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I saw her on the track earlier, and she 
was doing some pretty intense training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Is Ryan still out on the training course?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Yeah. I just saw them a moment ago, 
so I think they're still there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"It's no good, not with a final stretch 
like this...! I'll be left in the dust 
during the final duel...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I have to acquire the burst of speed 
needed to definitely catch them at the 
wire...! Because, I am—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I've been training all this time just to 
win in the Classics...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed, what incredible intensity...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(The strength and talent to carry 
expectations of conquering the 
Classics...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(And above all, her own tremendous 
effort...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(My feelings riding on the final Classic 
race, the Kikuka Sho, are naturally—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ......Even so, I...
choice_data_list:
So there really is something bothering 
you.

So there really is something bothering 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hah...! I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...This simply will not do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, but could you hear me out for 
just a moment?

I asked Mejiro McQueen about the cause of 
her anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize. I lost my focus due to 
personal reasons...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, to be completely frank.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I refuse to lose in long-distance 
races...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is why... the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, yeah. It makes me happy to hear you 
say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ryan?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry if it feels like I was 
eavesdropping. But I heard my name, so I 
got curious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Besides, what I felt back then was real.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I've brought myself to peak condition. 
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—No matter who my opponent is, I want to 
take them on with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(...Indeed. I, too, have ensured I am in 
peak condition. And I am equally serious 
about this—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to what you just said, I feel like 
I can finally remember.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All the hard work and hardships that had 
been built up until now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, by all means, in a race— let us 
have a serious duel at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah, it's a promise!

The stage of the contest is the Kikuka 
Sho— The battle between the Mejiro 
family's Umamusume begins.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't leave you to run out in front 
all alone like before."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I swear——I will stand by your side.
